## Specific task description

Task instruction: Stack the small smooth brown-rimmed bowl directly over the smooth bowl with glossy finish.

Task description: Stack the two separate bowls on the table, with the small bowl with a brown rim on top and the smooth glossy bowl on the bottom.

Success criteria: Position the small bowl directly above the glossy bowl with approximate horizontal overlap. Keep the lower bowl near the table and lower the upper to a low stacking height close to it. Both grippers must be open.

## Execution tips

- Choose a bowl-wall section near the rim and away from clutter, with one finger inside and one outside. Match the opening to wall thickness and clearance, confirming the fingers straddle the wall before closing rather than merely pressing the smooth rim and slipping.
- Keep the bowl opening upward during transport, with the lowest point of the upper bowl above the lower bowl’s rim. Use the open area in the middle of the table to adjust pose, reducing contact with nearby objects.
- When approaching the lower bowl, make small horizontal corrections above its opening and lower slowly. If fingers contact its rim first, retreat and adjust the approach pose rather than forcing downward and causing sliding or tipping.
- Release only after the upper bowl is supported by the lower one, then withdraw the fingers through an open gap, avoiding releasing while suspended or catching the rim during withdrawal.
